title: Regarding "Quick Access" Option in RPG Maker MZ 1.8.1

posts.author: MuriloMaker
posts.body:
I need clarification on the purpose and functionality of the "Quick Access" option located next to the Map Tree in RPG Maker MZ 1.8.1
I have reviewed the official RPG Maker documentation and searched existing support threads but have not found clear or specific information addressing this feature.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
then you didn't look enough, it is under basic editor controls
basically it's a favourite list for maps. you can add and remove maps from it so that you don't always have to search or scroll through the entire maptree
